class.name: VehicleComponentType
class.brief_description: What any vehicle can be asked for.
class.description: A kind of vehicle adds its own kinds after [constant COMPONENT_TYPE_MAX] ([RailVehicleComponentType]). A consumer names the kind, not the implementation: [code]VehicleServer.vehicle_component_get(rid, VehicleComponentType.COMPONENT_ENGINE)[/code] answers with a [RailVehicleEngine] whether the vehicle is diesel or electric. It is a class of its own, holding nothing, for two reasons: GDScript only sees an enum's constants as members of a registered class, and the component and the vehicle include each other, so neither of them can own it.

constants.constant: A scripted component ([GenericVehicleComponent]), found by its tag ([member VehicleComponent.component_tag]).
Where a kind of vehicle's own kinds start.
